info.title: RaceDay API
info.description: Event, registration and results API. Log in via POST /api/auth/login; the session cookie is then sent automatically by the browser.

post.summary: Register a new Organiser or Participant account.
post.description: Participants must supply a dateOfBirth. The password is stored hashed.

400.description: Invalid data, invalid role, or missing date of birth.

post.summary: Log in and start a session (cookie).

get.summary: Show who the current session belongs to.

200.description: Current user, role and profile id.

post.summary: Add a category (e.g. 10 km, 21 km, Under 20) to an event. Organiser only, own events only.

400.description: Invalid data or event does not exist.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

get.summary: Get all categories for an event. Public.

put.summary: Update a category. Organiser only, own events only.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

delete.summary: Delete a category. Organiser only, own events only.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

409.description: People have already registered for this category.

post.summary: Create an event. Organiser only; the event is owned by the logged-in organiser.

403.description: Logged in as a Participant.

get.summary: Get one event by ID. Public.

put.summary: Update an event. Organiser only, and only their own events.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

delete.summary: Delete an event (and its routes and categories). Organiser only, own events only.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

409.description: Event already has registrations or results.

get.summary: Get all events created by an organiser. An organiser can only list their own.

403.description: Not an organiser, or requesting another organiser's list.

get.summary: Get your own organiser profile. Organiser only.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your profile.

put.summary: Update your own organiser profile. Organiser only.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your profile.

409.description: Email already used by another account.

post.summary: Register a new participant account. Public.
post.description: Convenience endpoint from the Part 1 plan. Same as POST /api/auth/register with role Participant.

get.summary: Get a participant's profile. A participant can view only their own; an organiser can view participants registered for their events.

403.description: Not allowed to view this participant.

put.summary: Update your own participant profile. Participant only.

403.description: Not a participant, or not your profile.

409.description: Email already used by another account.

delete.summary: Delete a participant account, including their registrations and results. A participant can delete only themselves; an organiser only participants registered for their events.

403.description: Not allowed to delete this participant.

post.summary: Register the logged-in participant for an event category. Participant only.
post.description: The event must have status Open. Registering again after cancelling re-activates the registration.

400.description: Category does not exist or the event is not open.

403.description: Not a participant, or registering someone else.

get.summary: Get one registration. Owner participant, or the organiser of the event.

403.description: Not your registration.

put.description: Organisers (of the event) may set any values. Participants may only mark their own registration Paid or Cancelled.

403.description: Not your registration, or a participant attempting a change only organisers may make.

delete.summary: Cancel a registration. The owner participant or the event's organiser.
delete.description: The registration is kept with status Cancelled and its bib number is released.

403.description: Not your registration.

get.summary: Get all registrations of a participant. Participants can only view their own.

403.description: Not a participant, or not your registrations.

get.summary: Get all registrations for an event. Organiser only, own events only.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

put.summary: Update the payment status after a participant has paid.
put.description: Marking a pending registration as Paid also confirms it. Participants may only set Paid.

403.description: Not your registration, or a participant attempting a change only organisers may make.

put.summary: Assign a bib number to a paid participant. Organiser only, own events only.

400.description: Participant has not paid, or the registration is cancelled.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

409.description: Bib number already used in this event.

post.summary: Record a participant's result. Organiser only, own events only.
post.description: The participant must hold a non-cancelled registration for the given category, and the category must belong to the event.

400.description: Invalid data, category not in event, or participant not registered.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

409.description: Participant already has a result, or the position is taken in that category.

get.summary: Get all results for an event, ordered by category then position. Public.
Get a participant's own race results. Participants can only view their own.

403.description: Not a participant, or not your results.

put.summary: Update a result. Organiser only, own events only.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

409.description: Position already taken in this category.

delete.summary: Delete an incorrect result. Organiser only, own events only.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

post.summary: Create a route for an event. Organiser only, own events only.

400.description: Invalid data or event does not exist.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

get.summary: Get all routes for an event. Public.

put.summary: Update a route. Organiser only, own events only.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

delete.summary: Delete a route. Organiser only, own events only.

403.description: Not an organiser, or not your event.

participantId.description: Must be the logged-in participant's own ID.

EventDto.description: Used for both creating and updating an event.
